sequential_dependency.intermediate: Per ring: reconstructed 3x3 key, modal base, component cells and unique longest port run.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Recover each missing center from its eight inward-facing tile samples, then compute four-connected same-color nonbase components of that directional key.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Reflect only original tiles addressed by the selected run, across their radial row/column axes and into the outward destinations.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The selection is a spatially connected run in the recovered key, not the most common color in either the key or the original tile artwork; B needs its actual directional cell set.
